❤ [Up to 7.68kWh High Speed Charging, Adjustable Amperage from 16A to 32A & Requires a 20A to 40A circuit]: Maximum current output of 32 Amps for 40A circuit breaker, 24 Amps for 30A circuit breaker, or 16 Amps for 20A circuit breaker (Please pull out the charging gun, long press "A" button to change the current). ❤ [Question & Answer: Why can't find the device on app? or Can't find the device after changing phones]: Solutions: 1. Re-start and add your device again.

B0FP886BVQ.title: Level 2 EV Charger, 48Amp/11.5KW/240V, UL 2594, ETL & Energy Star
bullets: UP TO 9X FASTER CHARGING SPEED: The IYILO electric vehicle charging station delivers up to 46 miles of range per hour at 48A (11.5kW) via hardwired installation (60A breaker & licensed electrician required). Current is adjustable in 1A increments from 6A to 48A. Charges up to 9 times faster than a standard Level 1 charger

AUTOMATIC CONNECTOR OVERHEAT PROTECTION: Worried about your charging connector overheating? The IYILO J1772 charger connector features a built-in NTC sensor that tracks real-time temperature and shows it in the App. If the connector overheats (above 221°F), the system automatically stops charging to protect your EV from damage

UTILITY CHARGING PROGRAM SUPPORT: IYILO is currently joining local utility EV charging programs and has been listed on several official portals, including but not limited to ComEd, PSEG (NJ), PSEG-LI, Seattle City Light, Salt River Project, Portland General Electric, Oregon DOT, and Georgia Power ect. Through these programs, you can take advantage of local policy support and incentives. Moving forward, we will continue expanding our partnerships with major utilities and public agencies.

INTELLIGENT APP & SMART CHARGING CONTROL: The IYILO App features a smart, intuitive interface to set Time-of-Use (TOU) rates, track energy usage and cost, and manage multiple user accounts. It supports multiple charging modes, such as Scheduled charging and RFID card, while also offering OTA remote upgrades, ensuring optimal performance and longer lifespan. Note: Supports 2.4GHz WiFi only; 5GHz not supported

MULTIPLE CERTIFICATIONS: IYILO’s charging products have undergone rigorous testing and certification by several international professional laboratories, including but not limited to UL 2594 test report, ETL, Energy Star, and CSA. Furthermore, they have been reviewed by multiple influential industry experts and have received overwhelmingly positive acclaim.

SMART POWER MANAGEMENT: Built with a high-performance mainboard, the IYILO ev charger level 2 supports Power Sharing, allowing two chargers safely run on one circuit breaker without overloading. It also supports dynamic load balancing when paired with the Energy Meter (Available in charger + meter bundle), optimizing home energy use without upgrading your panel(Note: This feature requires the app and setting your circuit breaker threshold.)

COMPATIBLE WITH ALL J1772 EVS: The IYILO Level 2 EV Charger is ETL and Energy Star certified. It features a built-in GFCI breaker, ultra-flex cable, and NEMA 4 waterproof rating. This EV charger is engineered with a standard SAE J1772 connector and a 25ft charging cable, ensuring seamless compatibility with virtually all Electric Vehicles (EVs) and Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicles (PHEVs) in North America. Note: Compatible with Tesla models via the NACS adapter (adapter not included)

EASY INSTALLATION & RELIABLE SUPPORT: IYILO Electric Car Charger is designed for easy setup and installation. A complete installation guide is included in the package, and step-by-step videos or PDF manuals are available via the IYILO App. Based in the USA, IYILO proudly serves American customers with trusted support and fast service. We offer a 3-year warranty and dedicated customer service, available Monday to Friday, 8 AM- 12 PM, 4 PM- 8PM PST
